**Work Location:** On site

ZenRiva Capital Holdings is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to provide the analysis, reporting, and financial insight that support sound investment and business decisions.

This is not a purely reporting-focused role. You will be expected to understand the story behind the numbers, challenge assumptions, and give senior stakeholders a clear view of performance, risk, and opportunity.

You will work closely with finance leadership and operational stakeholders on planning, forecasting, investment analysis, and portfolio reporting. The role requires strong technical ability, but also the judgement to know what matters most in a decision.

Your work will include:

* Build and maintain financial models for forecasting, budgeting, investment evaluation, and scenario planning.

* Support monthly and quarterly management reporting, including income statements, cash flow, balance-sheet analysis, and variance commentary.
* Prepare financial materials for leadership reviews, investment discussions, and strategic planning.
* Review business cases, capital requests, and investment opportunities, including return analysis and sensitivity testing.
* Partner with operational teams to improve the quality of financial inputs, assumptions, and performance reporting.

* Assist with annual budgeting and rolling forecast cycles.
* Support due diligence, data-room preparation, and financial analysis connected with new initiatives or portfolio activity.

What you will bring

* Five or more years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, transaction advisory, or a related field.
* Advanced Excel skills and the ability to build clear, reliable financial models from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, cash flow, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Experience presenting financial findings to senior leaders or non-finance stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**About Clipboard**
===================

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

===================

As a Documents Compliance Analyst, you own the compliance decisions behind whether a healthcare professional is cleared to work: background check disqualifications, credential and risk review, and how new state requirements get implemented. You set the standard the team applies, and you are the named decision-maker when a case is hard. What the law requires is a given. How we meet it is up to you, and you own that call.

This is not a people management role. The work is recurring by design. The same categories of questions arrive every week, alongside state license renewals and reporting that run on a fixed calendar and never finish. Your value is in reaching the same well-reasoned decision every time and documenting your reasoning well enough that others can apply it. You'll work closely with Agents, SMEs, Team Leads, and Legal, none of whom report to you, so your credibility comes from the quality and consistency of your judgment rather than from authority.

You will report to the Head of the Documents Team.

* Serve as the named escalation point for background check disqualification decisions
* Make the initial call on agency compliance implementation
* Handle escalations on worker credential verification, including license violations and reprimands
* Decide which questions you resolve and document yourself, and which warrant partnering with Legal

**Written analysis**

* Produce risk analyses in a consistent format: the question, your research, your reasoning, your recommended path.
* Evaluate new state and agency requirements before implementation, quantifying what compliance costs a worker in time, money, and completion rate, and recommending how we implement.
* Build and maintain the decision record that lets other people reach the same conclusion you would

**Recurring compliance operations**

* Own the credential verification audits
* Plan and drive the implementation of high-value requirements, such as continuing education

* Ongoing state reporting

  + background screening adjudicator

* You can reach a defensible decision when documentation is incomplete or unavailable, and you're explicit about what your reasoning rests on.
* You can read complex regulatory material and work out how it applies in practice to a marketplace model.
* You weigh compliance risk against business impact and find the path that meets the requirement without restricting more than it demands.
* You write decision memos and business cases that leadership can act on.
* You build credibility with people who don't report to you.
* You own recurring work with hard deadlines, such as license renewals and state reporting.

* Experience with state licensing filings.

* Minimum i5 processor or equivalent

The Senior Financial Analyst aka Senior Decision Support Analyst is responsible for performing critical application and analysis functions in support of UCSF Health’s Financial Decision Support system. The analyst plays a critical role in maintaining the decision support system to ensure production of high-quality, accurate, and timely patient-level financial and clinical data for our Finance and Operational business partners. The decision support system is the single source of critical financial data that all Operating units, Vice Presidents, and Directors use to prepare ROI analyses for capital and value-improvement projects, develop case-based budgets, and provide program and service-line profitability reporting.

Responsibilities will include developing business cases and extracting cost, billing, patient demographic, and other information from the Health System cost accounting database and various dashboards and Business/Clinical Intelligence tools. A critical component of this position is the ability to establish effective working relationships with staff who have a deep understanding of UCSF IT applications and databases to develop the knowledge needed to analyze complex data sets.

Supports the Director – Shared Service in their overall strategy to achieve best practices in the management of the decision support system, and its associated reporting tools. To accomplish this, the Senior analyst must develop and maintain key relationships with other Financial and IT professionals.

  

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in a related area or four years of equivalent experience/training.
* Five or more years of experience in Decision Support or Financial Management in the Healthcare field, preferably in a hospital setting.
* Experience with hospital cost accounting (Strata/EPSi) concepts and systems, and familiarity/understanding of hospital and professional patient billing data including healthcare reimbursement concepts.
* Strata/EPSi cost accounting / decision support systems experience
* Knowledge of and experience working with healthcare specific EMR, Decision Support, and financial accounting software. (e.g. Epic, Strata/EPSi, Oracle or similar).
* Advanced data management and mining skills include ability to develop and execute highly complex SQL queries and stored procedures to organize, transform and extract financial and clinical data for production of relevant, meaningful reports, statistics, analyses and forecasts.
* Advanced interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead projects and teams and collaborate productively on highly complex projects with key personnel at all professional and technical levels.
* Advanced written and verbal communications skills, with the ability to interpret and convey highly sophisticated technical and financial information in a clear, concise manner, and to make cogent presentations of analyses, reports, and investigation results.
* Advanced problem-solving skills analytical ability, and in-depth knowledge of documentation and reporting, with the ability to run highly complex queries and studies, to collect and analyze financial and performance data, and to produce relevant, meaningful reports, analyses, and forecasts.
* In-depth ability to work with senior staff and managers across departments, serving as a technical leader and information resource in decision support, and providing recommendations and advice on decision support processes, business and financial issues, and industry trends and advances.
* The ability to work onsite when required.

Preferences:

* Advanced excel and power point skills.

**Position Summary:**

The Cost Analyst supports the Sr. Plant Controller by preparing, analyzing, and maintaining accurate cost accounting, inventory, and manufacturing financial information. This position assists with month-end close, standard costing, cost roll activities, inventory valuation, variance analysis, reporting, and process improvement. The role is responsible for producing timely and reliable financial data, investigating cost drivers, supporting cross-functional business partners, and helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and consistency of cost accounting processes across the organization.

**Responsibilities: Essential Duties**

* Support month-end close activities, including review and correction of production orders, recording of COGS and WIP activity, and analysis of production order variances.

The Cost Analyst supports the Sr. Plant Controller by preparing, analyzing, and maintaining accurate cost accounting, inventory, and manufacturing financial information. This position assists with month-end close, standard costing, cost roll activities, inventory valuation, variance analysis, reporting, and process improvement. The role is responsible for producing timely and reliable financial data, investigating cost drivers, supporting cross-functional business partners, and helping improve the accuracy, efficiency, and consistency of cost accounting processes across the organization.

**Responsibilities: Essential Duties**

* Support month-end close activities, including review and correction of production orders, recording of COGS and WIP activity, and analysis of production order variances.
* Prepare weekly and monthly inventory reporting and assist with inventory valuation, reserve analysis, and reconciliation activities.
* Calculate and maintain excess and obsolete inventory reserves in accordance with company policy and accounting requirements.
* Assist with quarterly and annual cost roll processes, including new part costing, standard cost updates, and validation of material, labor, overhead, freight, duty, and other cost components.
* Research purchase price variances, production variances, inventory adjustments, and other cost-related fluctuations; summarize findings and proposed corrective actions.
* Support analysis of product group profitability, manufacturing expenses, non-manufacturing expenses, and plant operating performance.
* Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking to support plant leadership, Finance, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Assist with departmental rate calculations and cost allocation analysis for Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and related support functions.
* Maintain and improve cost accounting records, supporting documentation, and system data integrity within ERP and reporting tools.
* Partner with Business Intelligence, Finance, and operational teams to improve reporting, automate recurring analyses, and enhance dashboard functionality.
* Support forecasts, budgets, and ad hoc financial analyses related to manufacturing costs, inventory, expenses, and cost savings initiatives.
* Assist with internal and external audit requests by preparing schedules, reconciliations, explanations, and supporting documentation.
* Comply with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), company accounting policies, internal controls, and financial reporting deadlines.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, cost control, data accuracy, and reporting efficiency within the cost accounting function.

**Expertise: Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of cost accounting, inventory accounting, standard costing, variance analysis, and manufacturing finance concepts.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and recurring financial analysis templates.
* Experience using ERP systems, preferably Epicor, and reporting tools such as Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to investigate variances and explain financial results clearly.
